SC Flags Flawed Denial Of Permanent Commission To IAF SSC Women Officers Orders Pension Relief
Times Now
7530000 subscribers
2 likes
1029 views
24 Mar 2026
The Supreme Court has delivered a landmark ruling, holding that the denial of permanent commission to Indian Air Force short service commission women officers was flawed. The court said the performance criteria under the 2019 policy was applied without giving a fair opportunity. It has directed pension and consequential benefits to affected officers as a one-time measure, marking a major relief for women SSC officers.

Secretary,[1](https://www.scobserver.in/supreme-court-observer-law-reports-scolr/sucheta-edn-v-union-of-india19626#footnote_1_19626 "2010 SCC OnLine Del 1116.") which held that all SSCWOs serving in the Army and Air Force were entitled to be considered for PC, an SSCWO in the Navy, namely, Annie Nagaraja (who is also the Appellant before us in Civil Appeal No. 5425/2025) along with several others, approached the High Court by way of Writ Petitions under Article 226 of the Constitution.
